thread:
alex: Heads up - AP3B gpu-nd-47 just went into a silent crash, loss of nvlink and >50% correctable ECC spikes. Scheduling a drain now.

sana: Oof. Which rack? can we live-route around it or do we need region shift?

alex: Rack ap3b-r12. Traffic started errors for a few hosts, autoscaler retried but kept failing. I'm kicking a local drain: `infra drain gpu-nd-47 --reason 'ECC surge'`

matt: Adding to runbook: follow node-drain -> deallocate -> mark-for-rma. If nvlink is flaky, performance across card pairs will be inconsistent. Suggest move critical capacity to eu-west temporarily.

irene: Can we prefer spare pool in ap3a first? cross-region adds egress + cost. How much spare capacity we have in ap3a?

leo: ap3a spare has ~40% free but it's already handling batch training spikes. eu-west has more cold spares. Cost delta estimated ~+18% for cross-region during shift.

sana: For customer SLAs we probably need to avoid cross-region unless perf degrades. What's the token latency impact right now? ops-bot: reported 95th p90 tokens latency +120ms for AP3B region in the last 5m.

ops-bot: Incident created INC-2026-1423: AP3B GPU node failure affecting some Dedicated pools. Link: https://incidents.redwood/INC-2026-1423

alex: Current plan: 1) Drain node; 2) Reroute live inference traffic away from affected AZ within ap3b (AZB -> AZC); 3) If p95 remains > target after 5m, shift canary routes to ap3a spares; 4) If still bad, scale eu-west warm pool.

matt: For draining, use grace period 30s, dont force-cancel in-flight KV cache. Command: `infra drain --node gpu-nd-47 --grace 30 --allow-inflight`

alex: Started drain. Logs:
```
[2026-03-18T09:15:23Z] drain: evicting 18 sessions
[2026-03-18T09:15:47Z] kvcache flush in progress
[2026-03-18T09:16:02Z] nvlink error: peer reset
[2026-03-18T09:16:10Z] node-mark: marking UNAVAILABLE
```

irene: Re-routing live traffic from AZB to AZC now. Doing 5% step increments using routing-policy canary.

sana: Watching evals. small spike in token error rates for two enterprise customers, but retries are catching. keeping an eye on cost counters if we have to go cross-region.

leo: If we RMA node, what's ETA for replacement hardware from provider? current lead is 72h for ap3b racks; we might request hot-swap spare but shop says limited availability.

matt: Can we provision a temporary dedicated instance in ap3a as a stopgap (bring-your-own preemptible style) to avoid eu-west? That would be ~+30% hourly but cheaper than cross-region egress.

alex: Agree. Ordering a temporary dedicated slot in ap3a now: `infra reserve --pool ap3a-temporary --gpu a100 --qty 1 --ttl 48h` — started.

ops-bot: Autoscaler: Provisioning request queued (req-3892). Estimated up by 3m.

sana: Also toggled caching aggressiveness to favor prefix reuse for affected customers to reduce token generation pressure.

irene: After 4m p95 down to +40ms from +120ms, error rates normalizing. Keep the replacement process but pause cross-region until RMA completes.

matt: For postmortem: capture ECC counters, nvlink logs, firmware versions. tagging this for eng-runtime and hw-supply.

alex: Noted. I'll attach node dump to the incident and open hw RMA ticket. Thanks all. :thumbsup:

leo: I'll track cost impact and update finance at EOD.

ops-bot: Incident INC-2026-1423 updated: status -> monitoring. Next update in 30m.
